proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
  intro T w F u a b hu
  classical
  obtain ⟨hlen, _, ht, hd⟩ :=
    M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.completion_word_split (w - 1) u a b hu
  obtain ⟨hpa, hga⟩ :=
    M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.prefix_algebra T _ (u.take (w - 1)) a
  obtain ⟨hpb, hgb⟩ :=
    M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.prefix_algebra T _ (u.drop (w - 1)) b
  simp only [M5.ArithmeticResidueRecovery.wordValid,
    M5.ConditionalResidueCount.feasible,
    hlen, ht, hd, M5.ConditionalResidueCount.selectedGcd,
    hpa, hpb, hga, hgb,
    Nat.gcd_assoc, Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_left_comm,
    true_and, and_true, eq_self_iff_true]
